text.description_html:
Acorn IMCBP Hand Forged Iron Art Door Push Plate

Acorn's Iron Art 15-3/4" by 3-1/2" push plate features a decorative arched top and bottom. Forged in Europe using the old world style of hammer and anvil, this push plate will add a medieval touch to any door. The black iron finish has a lifetime no-rust warranty. It is packaged complete with all mounting hardware for easy installation.

Also available: matching Door Pull and Plate

Specifications of the Acorn IMCBP Door Push Plate:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Plate Height 15-3/4"
  • Plate Width: 3-1/2"
  • Lifetime Finish Warranty

Sold individually. Package includes 1 push plate and hardware for a surface mounted application. This door push plate is handmade and all dimensions are approximate.
